data: ALTER TABLE bugsmodel ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS link_uuid UUID
UPDATE bugsmodel SET link_uuid = gen_random_uuid() WHERE link_uuid IS NULL
ALTER TABLE bugsmodel ALTER COLUMN link_uuid SET DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
ALTER TABLE bugsmodel ALTER COLUMN link_uuid SET NOT NULL

DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bugsmodel WHERE link_uuid IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bugsmodel GROUP BY link_uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'bugsmodel.link_uuid must be unique and non-null'; END IF; END $$
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_bugsmodel_link_uuid ON bugsmodel (link_uuid)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_result_bug_link (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), result_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES test_result(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, bug_uuid UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES bugsmodel(link_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uq_test_result_bug_link_pair UNIQUE (result_id, bug_uuid))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_test_result_bug_link_bug_uuid ON test_result_bug_link (bug_uuid)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_result_bug_create_operation (operation_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, actor_id UUID NOT NULL, result_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES test_result(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, bug_uuid UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_test_result_bug_create_operation_result ON test_result_bug_create_operation (result_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_test_result_bug_create_operation_bug_uuid ON test_result_bug_create_operation (bug_uuid)
